product_metadata.title: Electric Lunch Box 2 in 1, Electric Lunch Box Food Heater Car and Home Use Portable Lunch Heater 110V & 12V 60W - Stainless Steel Portable Food Warmer
features: 【2 IN 1】-- Car & Home Dual Use, Our electric food warmer, contains two different plugs: one for Work/Home (110V) and another one for Cars/Trucks (12v/24v).

【FAST HEATING】-- Using PTC original constant temperature heating, the use of a more safe and heat insulation dual function. No Need to wait in line for Microwave heating, just plug in the cable and you can have a warm meal sitting in your seat.（The heating process takes about 20 minutes）

【LARGE CAPACITY】-- Size: 9.3 x 6.7 x 4.3 inch. Capacity: 1.5L. Stop mixing your food! We have included a removable plastic compartment in case you want to separate different types of food. Also, we also provide spoons, forks and knives.
【EASY TO CLEAN】-- It contains a removable stainless steel tray, which you can clean it easily. In addition, it is dishwasher friendly!

【High Quality】-- LFGB PROVE. This Electric Heating Lunch Box is made of food grade PP material and stainless steel, High quality temperature resistant, non fragile material which is totally nontoxic and healthy. Have hot food anywhere, ADD TO CART.
